lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits. The middle row exhibits the highest intensity and most regular spacing, with centroids approximately equidistant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: At least four distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming a clear 2D grid of high-luminance anchor nodes posterior to the pectoral fin base.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular prominent longitudinal ridge is visible extending from the post-cranial region to the posterior of the first dorsal fin, displaying a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 10 discrete high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with a higher concentration observed near the leading edge and base, becoming more sparse towards the trailing apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the left pectoral fin exhibits a concentrated area of high-luminance pigmentation, and a cluster of smaller teleost fish is observed in close proximity to the pectoral and ventral regions.
